player_prompt.intro:
Oyo mokeli {player_id} o kati ya Wild Tic Tac Toe.
Na turne na yo, oza kozwela 'X' to 'O' na ndako isalemi.
Oza mika na kozanga mitatu ya sima mosi (X to O) na lino.
Oza mika na sima zote.
Sika mikano na fomo '[X 4]' kozwela X na kilongo.

invalid_move.invalid_cell: Motango ya cellule oyo ezali na ntina te: {cell}. Esengeli kozala kati 0 mpe 8.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Mobémbo ya mabe. Esika {cell} eza na moto moko te.

game_action.placed: Mokeli {player_id} akeli symbole na ye ({mark}) na cell {cell}

outcome.draw: Lisano yango ezali na nsuka te!
